page.running_head: De Agro Fris. inter Lavic. & Amas.

main_text.l: um ordine & sapientiâ valida in societa-

M. CCC. LXVIII, Ibi consensu omnium

l.i: judices, qui inter Amasum & Lavicam flumina

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "perAgrum" is printed without a visible space and may be two words (per Agrum); transcribed as printed. "nobiliate" and "populos" are as printed. The year "LXVIII" in small capitals is read as LXVIII (1368), with some uncertainty. The final line "flumina" is set right-aligned in italics; it is read as the last text line, but it could be a catchword for the next page, which is not visible. u/v corrected in "Unde" (vowel). Long s rendered as plain s throughout, including in the running head.
